venues.name: Tudor City Greens
venues.why: A planted pocket park for a bench and a book.
venues.hours: Official hours conflict; visit in daylight and follow posted gates.
venues.access: Open to visitors. No bicycles or dogs. Pin marks the south garden.

venues.name: St. Vartan Park Garden
venues.why: A small public garden; an easy pause among trees.
venues.access: Garden remains open during nearby playground construction through spring 2027. Park-area pin; garden entrance on First Avenue.

venues.name: Ford Foundation garden
venues.why: Indoor trees, a reflecting pool and a small art gallery.
venues.hours: Mon–Fri 11am–6pm. Sat 10am–4pm only during exhibitions. Closed Sun; check special closures.
venues.access: Register by 5pm the previous day. Photo ID and security screening; no large bags. Enter on E43rd.

venues.name: Stavros Niarchos Library
venues.why: Browse, read indoors, then take a rooftop air break.
venues.hours: Library: Mon–Thu 8am–9pm; Fri until 8pm; weekends 10am–6pm. Terrace has separate hours; holiday exceptions.
venues.access: Walk in; seating first come. Terrace café is closed. No e-bikes or e-scooters inside, except mobility aids.

venues.name: The Morgan Library & Museum
venues.why: Historic rooms, manuscripts, or just a café stop.
venues.access: Historic rooms free Tue/Sun 3–5pm. Full museum free Fri 5–8pm with reservation. Café/shop entry free. Garden seasonal, currently closed. Verify indexed-source details before travel.

venues.name: Japan Society
venues.why: A focused gallery visit or a scheduled film screening.
venues.hours: Gallery Tue–Fri 11am–5pm; weekends noon–6pm. Closed Mon and major holidays.
venues.access: Timed gallery tickets. Films follow their own calendar, not gallery hours; check the title and date.

venues.name: Pomme Palais
venues.why: Coffee, herbal tea and pastry at the Palace hotel.
venues.access: Public-facing café; no hotel stay required. Seating and quiet are not guaranteed. Hotel-building pin; café on the E51st side.

venues.name: Bathhouse Flatiron
venues.why: Warm pools, sauna and steam; a communal reset.
venues.price: Day pass from $39 · varies by slot
venues.access: Timed booking. Bring a swimsuit; towels and slippers included. Single entry, no re-entry. Not a float tank or a silent private spa.

venues.name: Gotham Pottery
venues.why: Paint a ready-made pot, or try beginner hand-building.
venues.hours: Studio daily 10am–10pm; book an actual session.
venues.access: Painting is 90 minutes; piece cost extra. Hand-building is two hours. Fired pieces require a later pickup, usually in about two weeks.

venues.name: Sivananda Yoga
venues.why: Gentle yoga with a meditative relaxation finish.
venues.hours: Class-specific; confirm a Gentle Yoga session.
venues.access: Walk-ins welcomed, but a current Gentle session was not verified. Check schedule and checkout rate; an Open Class is not the same offering.

venues.name: Ohm Spa
venues.why: A private, light-to-medium pressure Swedish massage.
venues.hours: By appointment; confirmed treatment time governs.
venues.access: Appointment required. No pool, sauna or day-pass access assumed. Use East 16th Street, not the old Fifth Avenue address.

venues.name: McNally Jackson · Rockefeller
venues.why: Fiction browsing, stationery and a literary detour.
venues.access: Check each event’s branch and date. No Grand Central Terminal branch appears in the official five-store list.

venues.name: Central Park · southeast entrance
venues.why: Enter at Grand Army Plaza for a south-end wander.
venues.hours: Check park notices before a late visit.
venues.access: Public park entrance at Fifth Avenue / E59th–60th. Start here for a walk; use designated cycling routes, not pedestrian paths.

venues.name: Roosevelt Island Tram · Manhattan
venues.why: An aerial river crossing; pair it with an island walk.
venues.access: Bicycles and mobility devices accommodated. Tram normally every 15 min; 7.5 min at weekday rush hours. Island park is a separate walk.

venues.name: FDR Four Freedoms Park
venues.why: Open sky, river views and a spare waterfront memorial.
venues.hours: 9am–5pm in winter; closed Tuesdays. Check holiday notices.
venues.access: The park is south of the tram; allow a separate island walk. No bicycles, scooters or pets inside; leave the bike outside. Food only in designated areas.
venues.address: 1 FDR Four Freedoms Park, Roosevelt Island

venues.name: East 34th Street · NYC Ferry
venues.why: The departure point for a Hunter’s Point park outing.
venues.hours: Use the live East River timetable; service varies by day.
venues.access: Choose East River Local or East River (A) serving Hunters Point South, not (B). Landing is at E35th / FDR. Bikes welcome, capacity subject to boarding. No seat reserved.

venues.name: Hunter’s Point South Park
venues.why: Waterfront paths and Manhattan skyline views.
venues.hours: Check posted park notices; current gate hours not verified.
venues.access: Pair with the East 34th Street ferry. Park pin is not the ferry dock: landing is at 54th Avenue / 2nd Street. No travel-time promise.
venues.address: Center Boulevard waterfront, Long Island City
venues.coordinate_source: Google Maps place coordinates in supplied Hunter’s Point South Park URL

venues.name: Lift / Next Level Floats
venues.why: A dedicated float pod or float room, beyond Manhattan.
venues.access: Current operator booking menu lists one-hour pods and float rooms. Appointment availability not checked. Second-floor location; step-free access not established. Deliberately farther than a local bike outing.

groups.name: The Millennialish Book Club
groups.note: Organizer page; check current events and meeting venue.

groups.name: Philosophy & Psychology Readers
groups.note: Public event listings; venues are event-specific.

groups.name: Astoria Book Club
groups.note: Historical social-post lead only. No current December meeting verified.

unmapped.name: UN Gift Garden / Good Defeats Evil
unmapped.note: Not a walk-in garden recommendation. The official tour listing describes a Chambers to Garden tour; visitors must pre-register for security. Current garden-tour dates and independent sculpture access are unverified. The UN pages blocked live retrieval; indexed official information only.
